# Register-ZbxActiveProxyDataProvider

## SYNOPSIS

Registers a scriptblock that supplies values for each upload of a running active proxy session.

## SYNTAX

```
Register-ZbxActiveProxyDataProvider [-Name] <string> [-ScriptBlock] <ScriptBlock> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The scriptblock runs on the session's own dedicated runspace, receiving the configuration last pulled as its argument; its last output, when it is a ZabbixProxyDataPage, is pushed (merged with every other registered provider's page) on the session's own refresh cadence (Start-ZbxActiveProxy -RefreshInterval / Set-ZbxActiveProxy -RefreshInterval). Several providers may be registered; each is asked every tick.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Push a value on every refresh

```powershell
Register-ZbxActiveProxyDataProvider -Name 'uplink' -ScriptBlock {
    param($config)
    $item = $config.Items.Values | Where-Object Key -eq 'app.requests'
    $now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
    $value = [Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyHistoryItem]::new($now.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(), $item.ItemId, $now, '42')
    [Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyDataPage]::new([Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyHistoryItem[]]@($value), $null, $null, $null, $null)
}
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' | Where-Object Key -eq 'app.requests' | Select-Object Key, LastValue
```

Before each refresh's upload the session runs the scriptblock on its own runspace (module commands are not there, so it builds SDK records directly), passing the configuration last pulled; a ZabbixProxyDataPage it returns is sent.

### Example 2: Push only when there is something to send

```powershell
Register-ZbxActiveProxyDataProvider -Name 'uplink' -ScriptBlock {
    param($config)
    $item = $config.Items.Values | Where-Object Key -eq 'app.status'
    if (-not $item) { return }
    $now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
    $value = [Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyHistoryItem]::new($now.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds() + 1, $item.ItemId, $now, 'ok')
    [Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyDataPage]::new([Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyHistoryItem[]]@($value), $null, $null, $null, $null)
}
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' | Where-Object Key -eq 'app.status' | Select-Object Key, LastValue
```

Returning nothing skips the tick. Several providers may be registered: each is asked every tick and their pages are merged into one upload.

## INPUTS

- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixActiveProxySession`: Represents an active proxy's uplink kept running as a session: it re-pulls the configuration on -RefreshInterval, over a ZabbixProxyUplink built with no DI container — the SDK type composes over a plain .
